findings.reason: Omits the English conditional 'if it's indicated by your setup', asserting the info is always available.

findings.suggestion: 텍스트에서 비디오로
findings.reason: Transliterated 'text to video' instead of the established Korean rendering; the hub glossary uses '텍스트에서 이미지로' for 'Text to image', so the video analogue should follow the same pattern.

findings.suggestion: 립싱크 비디오
findings.reason: The page uses '비디오' for 'video' in title, description and FAQ, but switches to '영상' here (and in '공유 가능한 영상'), creating inconsistent terminology within the same entry.

findings.suggestion: 실행 간 결과가 더 일관되게 나옵니다
findings.reason: English says results will be 'more consistent between runs'; the translation drops the comparative hedge and asserts consistency outright.

findings.suggestion: 등장방형(equirectangular) HDR 스카이박스 생성기
findings.reason: '적도 투영' literally means 'equatorial projection' and is not the established Korean rendering of 'equirectangular' (commonly '등장방형' / '정거원통도법', or kept as 'equirectangular'). Korean CG/game readers would not recognize the term; it recurs throughout the entry (description, extendedDescription, howToUse, faqItems) and should be fixed consistently.

findings.suggestion: 하이 다이내믹 레인지(HDR)
findings.reason: Unspaced transliteration '고다이내믹레인지' mixes a Korean prefix with an English transliteration and is not how Korean writers render 'high dynamic range'.

findings.suggestion: 시각적으로 인상적이고 정확하게
findings.reason: English says 'visually stunning and accurate'; '사실적' means 'realistic', which is a different claim than 'stunning'.
